text:
claire: quick UX sync on the routing editor iteration. pushed a prototype that groups rules into collapsible sections (service / user / fallback), adds a compact drag handle for priority reordering, and gates the preview sandbox when any rule group has validation errors. looking for feedback on keyboard drag affordances, group collapse affordance, and the copy for the preview-locked state. figma: https://figma.mock/new-groups omar: overall 👍. couple of things: 1) drag handle needs a larger hit area for touch and keyboard activation (16px icon but we should expose 32px tap target). 2) collapsed group headers should show a brief validation summary (e.g., "1 error") so people know why a group is closed. tony: accessibility notes: make the drag handle reachable via keyboard with a clear ARIA label (e.g., `aria-label="Move rule up or down"`) and add `aria-grabbed` state while moving. for touch, ensure reorder is also available via a context menu action to "Move up/Move down". leah: copy suggestion for the preview lock: current banner says "Preview disabled until rules are fixed" which feels terse. propose: "Preview sandbox is locked — resolve validation issues in the highlighted groups to enable simulation." longer but signals groups and highlights. also propose we add an inline icon + text (🔒 Preview locked) so it's visually scannable. claire: i like leah's phrasing. it's different from prior wording we used elsewhere. decision idea: 1) preview locked copy -> leah's suggestion; 2) show group-level error badges; 3) increase drag handle hit area to 32px and ensure keyboard activation works with Enter/Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Esc to cancel. omar: UI detail: when a user picks up a rule via keyboard, we should add a transient helper text: "Use ↑ / ↓ to move, Enter to drop" and announce `aria-live` status: "Rule moved to position 3" after drop. snippet: ```
Rule moved to position 3
``` tony: also suggest a focus-visible style for the handle: `.drag-handle:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.15); }` and ensure the group header collapse button has `aria-expanded` state. leah: small a11y copy tweak: change any use of word "fix" on disabled controls. prefer "resolve" or "address". also add an i18n key: `preview.locked.groups_unresolved = "Preview sandbox is locked — resolve validation issues in the highlighted groups to enable simulation."`. claire: implementation asks: - increase drag handle tap target and add keyboard reorder e2e; - group headers show `1 / 3 errors` pill and are focusable; - preview region set `aria-hidden=true` when locked; - add `role/status` aria-live updates for move/drop and validation changes; - add visual dim + lock icon for preview pane. omar: one more UX edge: when collapsing a group that contains the currently focused rule, ensure focus moves to the group header, not off-screen. otherwise keyboard users lose context. tony: agreed. recommend `.group-header:focus()` receive focus on collapse and announce `aria-live`: "Group \"Service\" collapsed, 2 errors". claire: can someone open the PR with these changes and include a small demo story in the component library showing keyboard reorder and locked preview state? include visual-regression snapshots for normal / locked preview / while dragging. add tests that assert `aria-grabbed` toggles and `role=status` messages appear. leah: i'll open branch leah/grouped-priority-drag-demo and include the i18n key, snapshots, and a short doc blurb explaining why preview is gated at group-level (safety + deterministic sim results). will ping a11y-bot for checks. a11y-bot: queued accessibility smoke tests for branch leah/grouped-priority-drag-demo — will report results in thread. claire: thanks team! this should make complex policies easier to scan and safer to simulate. :thumbsup:
